steps.title: First-run window
steps.expected: The Set up ModelPlan window; the widget is at the right edge.

steps.title: Just after Done
steps.expected: D56: the widget slides out from its strip and the rest of its display, menu bar included, is dimmed to about 60 % with a soft bright ring around the widget.

steps.title: After the first-run spotlight
steps.expected: The dim is gone and the widget has collapsed again to its strip at the right edge.

steps.title: Status menu, right click
steps.expected: The status menu has Find Quota Widget right below Show Quota Widget.

steps.title: Find Quota Widget
steps.expected: D56: the widget slides out and the rest of its display dims with a soft ring around it.

steps.title: After Find Quota Widget
steps.expected: About 1.5 s later the dim has faded and the widget has collapsed again.
